verdict.rationale: Galileo docs mention that users can set up alerts on logs to be notified of unexpected events, which is a basic rule-trigger-on-event capability, but there is no detail on defining custom rule logic, condition types, or automated actions beyond alerting (e.g., webhooks, workflow triggers, remediation actions). missing for 10: rule definition UI/API details, supported trigger conditions, and evidence of automated actions beyond simple alert notifications.
